messages:
Jules: FYI — DataScale renewal is 5/3. ARR $120k. Onboarding still at ~60% — SSO + embeddings outstanding. Procurement says they might need a 9-month term instead of 12.
Anita: Thanks. What level of discount are they asking for with shorter term?
Priya (DataScale): Hi — procurement asked if we can pro-rate and offer a $15k credit for SSO implementation delay. Also need private deployment checklist signed.
Jules: Noted. @Ben and @Rory need to confirm legal/finance on credit and term. Also they want signatures via DocuSign.
Ben: Legal — short term ok if we keep unit pricing and pro-rate. Need amendment that sets term_end and a one-time credit line. I'll draft.
Rory: Finance — pro-rate is fine, but we need PO before we send DocuSign. If they can e-sign we can invoice same cycle. Priya, can procurement get us a PO number this week?
Priya (DataScale): I'll ask procurement today, likely get PO by Fri. Onboarding is blocked on our infra team for SSO config — ETA 2 weeks.
Jules: Ok — plan: Ben will send amendment draft here, Anita will confirm pricing, Rory will wait for PO, I'll coordinate enablement session post-sign.
Ben: Draft ready — pasted below:
```
Amendment: change term length to 9 months (pro-rated total), one-time implementation credit $15,000, payment upon PO receipt, signatures via DocuSign.
```
Ben: Sending DocuSign once PO is uploaded. @Priya ping when PO available.
Anita: Confirmed — revenue impact reviewed, approve credit. Will update renewal revenue forecast.
OnboardBot: [Automated] SSO checklist created: items 1-4. Current progress: 2/4.
Priya (DataScale): PO uploaded to shared folder: link: https://files.datascale.com/po-4321 — please confirm.
Rory: Got PO. Forwarding to billing. Ben please proceed with DocuSign.
Ben: DocuSign sent: https://docusign.com/abc123 — chasing signatures. I've attached amendment draft to envelope.
Jules: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m handoff with enablement once signatures are done. :thumbsup:
